turns.speaker: user
turns.text: My son is on his tablet and phone till midnight. Something has to change.

turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: You can control that from your own phone. Lock his apps after a set bedtime, or give him a daily allowance of hours?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Let me talk to Alex for a bit, so please stay quiet until I say I'm back.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Alex, can we put the fan on? It's like an oven in here.

turns.speaker: friend
turns.text: It's so noisy though. I'll never sleep.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: I'll never sleep without it. I'm literally sticking to the sheets.

turns.speaker: friend
turns.text: What if we open the windows instead?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Then the mosquitoes come in. You remember last week?

turns.speaker: friend
turns.text: Okay, fan on, but point it at you, not me.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Deal. And I'll put a bowl of ice in front of it.

turns.speaker: friend
turns.text: Does that actually work, or is that one of your internet tricks?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Sorry, I'm back now. Go ahead.

turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: Okay. Your son's late nights on the phone. Bedtime lock or daily hours?
